name: Troy A. Duffy
tagline: Top rated Workers' Compensation attorney in Columbus, Ohio
about: Troy A. Duffy, an attorney with Reminger in Columbus, Ohio, helps clients address Workers' Compensation: Employer / Insurance situations.
He received legal training from Capital University Law School. He graduated from law school in 2013. Troy Duffy became licensed to practice law in 2013.
Troy Duffy was selected to Rising Stars. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Rising Stars for 2020 - 2027.
